features.title: Big stories need a clear foundation.
features.intro: Keep multiple books in one library, with distinct writing, source checks, reference drafts and versions. External agents are optional; authors make the decisions.

items.title: One story bible. A connected world.
items.body: Keep characters, factions, places and timelines together. Checks cite sources and make uncertainty visible.

workflow.title: From the first chapter to the next medium.
workflow.intro: Move from a multi-book library to a focused workspace. Reviewing a reference, adopting it and finalizing text are separate decisions. Work manually or choose an external agent.

steps.title: Create a book and its canon
steps.body: Keep each book’s details, cover, chapters and story bible independent. Begin planning without a title or an agent.

steps.title: Write and adapt
steps.body: Write chapters, organize existing plot beats, then outline episodes and scenes. The core structures material; it does not invent dialogue.

steps.title: Review, adopt, finalize
steps.body: Inspect sources and checks, then record a review. Adopt selected text into an editable manuscript and finalize a saved revision separately.

steps.title: Save and version
steps.body: Saving text and creating Git snapshots are separate. Prepare fixed files, identity and changes for author approval. Remote collaboration needs its own authorization.

details.title: Suggestions are not canon
details.body: Discovered names, places and relationships remain candidates. Only author-confirmed content enters the story bible.

details.title: Checks are not literary judges
details.body: Rules inspect explicit facts and structure, reporting coverage and uncertainty. Motivation and literary choices stay with the author.

details.title: Review, adoption and finalization are separate
details.body: Review approval does not overwrite text. Adoption saves a new working revision; finalization records an author decision on an exact revision. Later edits retain earlier finals.

details.title: Prepare delivery from actual capabilities
details.body: Keep Markdown or Fountain sources, provenance and local versions. Check the recipient’s template. Complete bundles and format conversion depend on the specific release capabilities.

open.title: The tools keep it together. The story is yours.
open.body: No built-in models or generation-service lock-in. Readable files, Git history and open MCP let you choose your own creative process.

integrations.title: Agents assist. Authors decide.
integrations.intro: The standalone stdio MCP server binds one author-selected local workspace. External agents can read canon, submit references and organize structure. Hetu Luoshu includes no chat, models or generation API.

layers.title: Story bible and rules
layers.body: Author-confirmed canon is the baseline. Agents cannot unlock or rewrite canon, or approve their own drafts.

layers.title: MCP tools and resources
layers.body: Canon reads, reference submission, plot, drama outlines, checks and author-approved snapshots use current core contracts. The list below comes directly from the machine tool catalog.

layers.title: Task handoff and candidate return
layers.body: The integration design covers choosing a client, installing an extension, copying a task prompt and receiving candidates. Plugins, Apps and local browser interactions need separate host verification.

integrations.status: Tools come from the current repository catalog. Installing an extension does not grant full file or Git permissions. Real host compatibility is verified separately from the application build.
integrations.manual: A complete workflow without an agent
integrations.manualBody: The local client supports manual book creation, editing, canon, structural checks, review, adoption, finalization and local snapshots. External collaboration is optional. This website establishes no real connection.

formats.title: Editable for authors. Readable for recipients.
formats.body: Current manuscripts use Markdown and independent scripts use Fountain. DOCX, PDF and complete bundles are delivery designs whose availability depends on the release capabilities. Check recipient templates, Chinese typography and media rights.

faq.title: Know the boundaries before you begin.

items.q: Will Hetu Luoshu write my novel for me?
items.a: No. The core contains no model or generation API. It organizes canon, storage, extraction, validation, review and delivery. Write manually or choose your own external agent.

items.q: Can an agent change my story bible?
items.a: Managed interfaces do not let agents change canon, unlock it or approve their own drafts. Locks control the authoring workflow. Other programs still operate under OS file permissions; Hetu Luoshu does not claim absolute isolation.

items.q: Will consistency checks detect every out-of-character moment?
items.a: No. Deterministic checks require explicit facts and structure. Complex motivation, personality and expression receive source-backed advisories with coverage and uncertainty. Authors make the final judgment.

items.q: Which platforms and languages are included?
items.a: Development implementations include the native macOS client, Rust core, Swift CLI and standalone MCP server, with Chinese and English interfaces. Windows follows full Mac verification as a separate implementation. Mobile visuals are concepts only.
0.2.0 publishes source, the website and its homepage demo. Follow the repository instructions to build a local macOS development app. Its ad-hoc signature is not a notarized distribution package.

items.q: Will my work be uploaded or become open source?
items.a: Author IP workspaces are separate from the software repository. The core runs locally, without collecting manuscripts or uploading by default. Remote Git and external agents require explicit selection and authorization.

items.q: How do I deliver a novel or script?
items.a: Keep Markdown or Fountain text, revisions and provenance, and agree on the recipient’s template. DOCX, PDF conversion and complete bundles require release-specific verification. The homepage demo creates no delivery files.

items.q: What are the license and costs?
items.a: The core repository uses Apache-2.0. Multimedia routing is a separate optional plugin direction, with providers chosen by users. The core has no compute billing or generation-service dependency.
